title: readings totally off
symptom: After replacing a Libre sensor and using with Blucon and xDrip latest stable, readings are completely off, about 30 or 40 difference with blood testing and the Libre scanner, despite initial calibrations and several during the day.
fix: Resetting the xDrip app completely (Android data delete) seemed to help a little, but the thread does not confirm a definitive fix.
evidence_quote: now after resetting the xdrip app completely (android data delete, strangely enough no cache data) seems a little better.
